pagetitle: "CHART checklist"
page-layout: full
toc: false
resources:
  - /assets/logos/equator_logo.png
  - docx.min.js
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #tp-wrap { --accent:#2a5aa7; --head:#bfbfbf; --sect:#b4c6e7; --box:#eef3fb; --boxline:#9fb6dc; --line:#000;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#111; max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; }
  /* Equator logo: hidden on screen, shown only in the saved PDF (print) */
  #tp-wrap .tp-top { text-align:right; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:none; width:150px; height:auto; margin-left:auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:21px; font-weight:bold; line-height:1.3; margin:0 0 .2rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; margin:.4rem 0 .8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; width:100%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { flex:0 1 50%; min-width:0; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; padding:.35rem .5rem;
    border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); background:var(--box); border-radius:3px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:13px; line-height:1.35; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px 6px; vertical-align:top; text-align:left; }
  #tp-wrap thead th { background:var(--head); font-weight:bold; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sec td { background:var(--sect); font-weight:bold; padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap td.topic { width:17%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap td.item { width:7%; text-align:center; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap td.txt.sub { padding-left:22px; }
  #tp-wrap th.pgh, #tp-wrap td.pg { width:13%; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { padding:3px; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#6a7fa3; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot, #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:12.5px; margin:.6rem 0 0; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #2a5aa7; background:#2a5aa7; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#2a5aa7; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 portrait; margin:12mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:block; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:10.5px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:16px; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-foot, #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:9.5px; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap tr.sec td { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { border:0; padding:0; background:none; flex:1 1 auto; }
  }
</style>

<div id="tp-wrap">
  <div class="tp-top"><img src="/assets/logos/equator_logo.png" alt="EQUATOR Network" class="tp-eq"></div>
  <div class="tp-title">The CHART Checklist</div>
  <div class="tp-actions">
    <button type="button" id="tp-pdf">Save as PDF</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-doc" class="alt">Save as Word</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-reset" class="alt">Clear all</button>
    <p class="tp-note">Type the page number(s) where each item is reported in the boxes in the right-hand column (or “supp” and the appendix number if it is in a supplementary appendix), then save your copy as a PDF or Word (.docx) file.
    “Save as PDF” opens your browser’s print dialog: choose <em>Save as PDF</em> as the destination.
    Your entries stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-meta"><label>Manuscript title: <input type="text" id="tp-title" data-key="title" placeholder="Type your manuscript title here"></label></div>
  <table id="tp-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>HEADING</th><th class="c">#</th><th>CHART CHECKLIST ITEM</th>
      <th class="pgh">Page #<sup>*</sup><span class="tp-hint">type page no. in the boxes below</span></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <p class="tp-foot"><sup>*</sup>If in supplementary appendix, indicate “supp” and appendix #, if applicable.</p>
  <p class="tp-cite">Citation: The CHART Collaborative. Reporting guideline for chatbot health advice studies: the Chatbot Assessment Reporting Tool (CHART) statement. BMJ Med. 2025; 4(1):e001632. <a href="https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjmed-2025-001632" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjmed-2025-001632</a>. Explanation and elaboration: The CHART Collaborative. BMJ. 2025; 390:e083305.</p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // Section bars are plain strings; otherwise [topic, indented?, [[item no, text], ...]]
  const ROWS = [
 "Title & Abstract",
 [
  "Title",
  false,
  [
   [
    "1a",
    "State that the study is assessing one or more generative AI-driven chatbots for clinical evidence or health advice."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Abstract/Summary",
  false,
  [
   [
    "1b",
    "Apply a structured format, if applicable."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 "Introduction",
 [
  "Background",
  false,
  [
   [
    "2a",
    "State the scientific background, rationale, and healthcare context for evaluating the generative AI-driven chatbot(s), referencing relevant literature when applicable."
   ],
   [
    "2b",
    "State the aims and research questions including the target audience, intervention, comparator(s), and outcome(s)."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 "Methods",
 [
  "Model Identifiers",
  false,
  [
   [
    "3a",
    "State the name and version identifier(s) of the generative AI model(s) and chatbot(s) under evaluation, as well as their date of release or last update."
   ],
   [
    "3b",
    "State whether the generative AI model(s) and chatbot(s) are open-source or closed-source/proprietary."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Model Details",
  false,
  [
   [
    "4a",
    "State whether the generative AI model was a base model or a novel base model, tuned model, or fine-tuned model."
   ],
   [
    "4b",
    "If a base model is used, cite its development in sufficient detail to identify the model."
   ],
   [
    "4c",
    "If a novel base model, tuned model, or fine-tuned model is used, describe the pre- and/or post-implementation/deployment data and parameters."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Prompt Engineering",
  false,
  [
   [
    "5a",
    "Describe the evolution of study prompt development."
   ],
   [
    "5ai",
    "Describe the sources of prompts."
   ],
   [
    "5aii",
    "State the number and characteristics of the individual(s) involved in prompt engineering."
   ],
   [
    "5aiii",
    "Provide details of any patient and public involvement during prompt engineering."
   ],
   [
    "5b",
    "Provide study prompts."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Query Strategy",
  false,
  [
   [
    "6a",
    "State route of access to generative AI model."
   ],
   [
    "6b",
    "State the date(s) and location(s) of queries for the generative AI-driven chatbot(s) including the day, month, and year as well as city and country."
   ],
   [
    "6c",
    "Describe whether prompts were input into separate chat session(s)."
   ],
   [
    "6d",
    "Provide all generative AI-driven chatbot output/responses."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Performance Evaluation",
  false,
  [
   [
    "7a",
    "Define the ground truth or reference standard used to define successful generative AI-driven chatbot performance."
   ],
   [
    "7b",
    "Describe the process undertaken for generative AI-driven chatbot performance evaluation."
   ],
   [
    "7bi",
    "State the number and characteristics of team members involved in performance evaluation."
   ],
   [
    "7bii",
    "Provide details of any patients and public involvement during the evaluation process."
   ],
   [
    "7biii",
    "State whether evaluators were masked to the identity of the generative AI-driven chatbot(s) under assessment."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Sample Size",
  false,
  [
   [
    "8",
    "Report how the sample size was determined."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Data Analysis",
  false,
  [
   [
    "9a",
    "Describe statistical analysis methods, including any evaluation of reproducibility of generative AI-driven chatbot responses."
   ],
   [
    "9ai",
    "Report the measures used for performance evaluation."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 "Results",
 [
  "",
  false,
  [
   [
    "10a",
    "Report the alignment between generative AI-driven chatbot output and ground truth or reference standard using quantitative or mixed methods approaches as applicable."
   ],
   [
    "10b",
    "For responses deviating from the ground truth or reference standard, state the nature of the difference(s)."
   ],
   [
    "10c",
    "Report the assessment for potentially harmful, biased, or misleading responses."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 "Discussion",
 [
  "",
  false,
  [
   [
    "11a",
    "Interpret study findings in the context of relevant evidence."
   ],
   [
    "11b",
    "Describe the strengths and limitations of the study."
   ],
   [
    "11c",
    "Describe the potential implications for practice, education, policy, regulation, and research."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 "Open Science",
 [
  "Disclosures",
  false,
  [
   [
    "12a",
    "Report any relevant conflicts of interest for all authors."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Funding",
  false,
  [
   [
    "12b",
    "Report sources of funding and their role in the conduct and reporting of the study."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Ethics",
  false,
  [
   [
    "12c",
    "Describe the process undertaken for ethical approval."
   ],
   [
    "12ci",
    "Describe the measures taken to safeguard data privacy of patient health information, as applicable."
   ],
   [
    "12cii",
    "State whether permission/licensing was obtained for the use of original, copyrighted data."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Protocol",
  false,
  [
   [
    "12d",
    "Provide a study protocol."
   ]
  ]
 ],
 [
  "Data availability",
  false,
  [
   [
    "12e",
    "State where study data, code repository, and model parameters can be accessed."
   ]
  ]
 ]
];
  const TITLE = "The CHART Checklist";
  const HEAD = ["HEADING", "#", "CHART CHECKLIST ITEM", "Page #*"];
  const FOOT = ["*If in supplementary appendix, indicate “supp” and appendix #, if applicable.", "Citation: The CHART Collaborative. Reporting guideline for chatbot health advice studies: the Chatbot Assessment Reporting Tool (CHART) statement. BMJ Med. 2025; 4(1):e001632. [[https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjmed-2025-001632|https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjmed-2025-001632]]. Explanation and elaboration: The CHART Collaborative. BMJ. 2025; 390:e083305."];
  const WIDTHS = [1900, 750, 6616, 1200];

  // Sub-items such as 5ai, 7biii, 12cii (digits + one letter + i/ii/iii) are indented
  const isSub = code => /^\d+[a-z]i+$/.test(code);

  const STORE = "chart-checklist-v1";
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tp-table tbody");
  tbody.innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => {
    if (typeof r === "string") return `<tr class="sec"><td colspan="4">${r}</td></tr>`;
    const [topic, , items] = r, n = items.length;
    return items.map(([code, text], i) =>
      `<tr>` + (i ? "" : `<td class="topic" rowspan="${n}">${topic}</td>`) +
      `<td class="item">${code}</td><td class="txt${isSub(code) ? " sub" : ""}">${text}</td>` +
      `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="p${code}" placeholder="page no. / supp" aria-label="Page, item ${code}"></td></tr>`).join("");
  }).join("");

  const fields = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    fields().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {}; fields().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  // Save as PDF via the browser print dialog (print CSS shows only the checklist)
  document.getElementById("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = "CHART checklist";
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  document.getElementById("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all page numbers and the manuscript title?")) { fields().forEach(i => i.value = ""); save(); }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  // <BUILD>
  function buildDocx(D, ROWS, vals, title, head, foot, widths, eqLogo) {
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 17, W = widths, TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
    const ln = { style: D.BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "000000" };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold });
    const runs = (text, o = {}) => {
      const out = [], re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        if (m.index > last) out.push(run(text.slice(last, m.index), o));
        out.push(new D.ExternalHyperlink({ link: m[2], children: [new D.TextRun({ text: m[1], font: F, size: o.size || SZ, color: "0563C1", underline: {} })] }));
        last = re.lastIndex;
      }
      if (last < text.length) out.push(run(text.slice(last), o));
      return out;
    };
    const cell = (i, text, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: o.span ? TOTAL : W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnSpan: o.span ? 4 : undefined, rowSpan: o.rowSpan,
      verticalAlign: o.mid ? D.VerticalAlign.CENTER : D.VerticalAlign.TOP,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: o.indent || 90, right: 90 }, borders: { top: ln, bottom: ln, left: ln, right: ln },
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ keepNext: o.keepNext, alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children: runs(text, o) })]
    });
    const hd = { fill: "BFBFBF", bold: true, mid: true };
    const header = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: [
      cell(0, head[0], hd), cell(1, head[1], { ...hd, center: true }), cell(2, head[2], hd), cell(3, head[3], { ...hd, center: true })] });
    const body = ROWS.flatMap(r => {
      if (typeof r === "string") return [new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r, { span: true, fill: "B4C6E7", bold: true, keepNext: true })] })];
      const [topic, , items] = r;
      return items.map(([code, text], i) => new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [
        ...(i ? [] : [cell(0, topic, { rowSpan: items.length, bold: true })]),
        cell(1, code, { center: true, bold: true }), cell(2, text, { indent: isSub(code) ? 330 : 90 }),
        cell(3, vals["p" + code] || "", { center: true, mid: true })] }));
    });
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, ...o, children });
    const footer = new D.Footer({ children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: D.AlignmentType.CENTER,
      children: [new D.TextRun({ children: ["Page ", D.PageNumber.CURRENT, " of ", D.PageNumber.TOTAL_PAGES], font: F, size: 18 })] })] });
    const top = [
      ...(eqLogo ? [para([new D.ImageRun({ data: eqLogo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 140, height: Math.round(140 * 90 / 310) } })], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT, spacing: { after: 60 } })] : []),
      para([run(title, { bold: true, size: 26 })], { spacing: { after: 100 } }),
      para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } })
    ];
    return new D.Document({
      title: title, creator: title,
      sections: [{
        footers: { default: footer },
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 800, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [...top, new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [header, ...body] }),
          ...foot.map((t, i) => para(runs(t, { size: 16 }), { spacing: { before: i ? 60 : 140 } }))]
      }]
    });
  }
  // </BUILD>

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      let eqLogo = null;
      try { eqLogo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/equator_logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {}; fields().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, ROWS, vals, TITLE, HEAD, FOOT, WIDTHS, eqLogo));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = "CHART-checklist.docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
